nested_development_split.grouping: identity_component; exact and near-duplicate links inherited from Phase 2F

lanes.A: recognizer-only on every Phase 2H selected development crop that reached OCR
lanes.B: development intersection of Phase 2H correctly-framed failure inventory
lanes.C: 69 development admission residuals using frozen Phase 2I-A shadow candidates only

configuration_schedule.internal_validation: one frozen final challenger configuration plus frozen agreement policies

runtime_selection_policies.challenger_fixed: return the one frozen challenger output
runtime_selection_policies.preserve_current_on_disagreement: return current output whenever normalized full-string outputs differ
runtime_selection_policies.exact_agreement_review_disagreement: auto-accept only identical full-string outputs; otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW
runtime_selection_policies.three_way_exact_agreement: auto-accept only identical full-string outputs from the frozen three configurations; otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW

candidate_generation: all crops, views, raw reads, confidence, provenance, latency and resource data are generated before truth is loaded
evaluation: truth is loaded only in a separate process and raw values never enter aggregate reports
